args.subject: Private Dining Table Request for 12 – Friday, May 17, 2024
args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing on behalf of Emma Johnson to request a private dining table for 12 guests on Friday, May 17, 2024.

We would love to enjoy your private dining experience at New Asiaway, located at 123 Rue de la Gaite, 75014 Paris, France. The restaurant is open on Fridays from 12:00 PM to 3:00 PM and from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM, so we would be happy to accommodate whichever service time works best for you — please let us know what availability you have for our group of 12.

If you could also share any details regarding a set menu, minimum spend, or deposit requirements, and whether there are any dietary accommodations we should be aware of, it would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you very much for your time, and we look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
